data.title: Polymarket Fulham FC Second-Half Over 1.5 Odds Jump to 31%
data.description: Catcher Predict monitoring showed sharp volatility in the Polymarket submarket "Fulham FC Second-Half O/U 1.5" under the "Liverpool FC vs. Fulham FC - More Markets" event, with the "Over" option rising from 11% one hour earlier to 31% at present. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 20% swing and may have been affected by breaking news.

data.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian Meets Ethiopian Prime Minister at BRICS Summit
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian President Pezeshkian met with Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed during the BRICS summit.

data.title: Iran Civil Aviation Spokesperson Denies Rumors of Turkish Airport Service Suspension
data.description: According to Jin10, the spokesperson for Iran's Civil Aviation Organization denied rumors that Turkey had stopped providing airport services and ground handling for Iranian airlines, and said Iranian airlines' flight operations were continuing as scheduled.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Xi to Take Spotlight at Modi’s BRICS Summit as Iran War Deepens
data.description:
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to open a BRICS summit in New Delhi that will try to find common ground as the war in the Middle East escalates, according to Bloomberg.

The gathering comes as the conflict threatens to widen divisions among the bloc’s members.

data.title: Iranian President: Relations With Neighboring Countries Are a Main Strategy
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian President Pezeshkian said that developing relations with neighboring and brotherly countries is one of the main strategies of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

data.title: SemiAnalysis Acquires Citrini Research, Bloomberg Reports
data.description: SemiAnalysis has acquired independent investment research firm Citrini Research, according to Bloomberg. According to PANews, Citrini Research founder James van Geelen will remain chief executive for now, and the firm will retain some operational independence rather than being fully folded into the SemiAnalysis brand. The transaction price was not disclosed.

data.title: Summit Place Financial Advisors Founder Says Fed Rate Hike Is Fundamentally Unnecessary
data.description: According to Jin10, Liz Miller, founder and president of U.S. wealth management firm Summit Place Financial Advisors, said further tightening is fundamentally unnecessary despite broad market expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates next week, citing overall economic stability.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Middle East Oil Dependence Has Fallen to About 50%
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said the country's dependence on Middle East crude oil has fallen from as high as 70% to about 50% in a few months, and that citizens do not need to worry about oil prices.

data.title: Revolut Users’ Personal Data Reportedly Exposed After Fraudulent Request Was Not Identified
data.description:
ZachXBT said Revolut may have failed to identify a fraudulent request, leading to the exposure of some users’ personal identity information. According to Odaily, the leaked data included passport or driver’s license copies and verification selfies, account statements, IBANs, withdrawal records, full transaction histories including Bitcoin transactions, and names, dates of birth, occupations, home addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers.

ZachXBT said the incident may have affected a limited number of users and appeared to target high-net-worth customers. Several Revolut users reportedly received security alert emails yesterday.

data.title: India's Securities and Exchange Board Proposes Continuing Indicative Equilibrium Prices During Closing Auction
data.description: According to Jin10, India's Securities and Exchange Board proposed continuing to publish indicative equilibrium prices for stocks during the closing auction session.

data.title: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung Says Domestic Refined Oil Prices and Supply Remain Stable
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung said that despite surging crude oil and international refined oil prices, South Korea is maintaining stable domestic refined oil prices and supply through a price cap system and export volume controls.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Oil Import Diversification Will Continue
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he will continue to strongly promote diversification of crude oil imports.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Fuel Prices Will Remain Stable
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said South Korean citizens need not worry and that gasoline, diesel, and other refined oil prices will continue to remain stable.

data.title: Iranian Parliament National Security Committee Chair Ibrahim Azizi: No Negotiations
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Parliament National Security Committee Chair Ibrahim Azizi said there will be no negotiations and that talks are meaningless unless Iran's conditions are met.

data.title: Iran's Bushehr Airport Resumes First International Flight After Six-Month Suspension
data.description: According to Jin10, the head of the Bushehr Province Airport Administration said Bushehr Airport resumed its first international flight after a six-month suspension, with the Bushehr-Dubai route operated by Qeshm Air.

data.title: BIS Report Says AI Is Shrinking Banks' Window to Fix Software Flaws
data.description:
A new report from the Bank for International Settlements says advanced AI is shortening the time banks have to fix software flaws before attackers exploit them. According to ChainCatcher, the report warns that periodic security reviews and scheduled patch updates are increasingly insufficient, as the window between vulnerability discovery and exploitation has narrowed from weeks to minutes.

The report focuses on banks' response capabilities and argues that financial institutions must speed up software remediation and accelerate related authorization decision-making processes.

data.title: Iraqi Lawmaker Warns Against U.S. Interference in Domestic Affairs
data.description: According to Jin10, Iraqi lawmaker Mohammed al-Hassanawi warned against U.S. interference in domestic affairs, saying Iraq's cabinet has still not been fully formed because the United States controls many key sectors in Iraq and interferes in its domestic affairs.

data.title: Canada's OSFI Says Tokenized Deposits Are Legally Equivalent to Traditional Deposits
data.description:
Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions said tokenized deposits are not legally different from traditional deposits and that the underlying technology used in a financial product or service does not determine its legal nature. According to Odaily, the regulator said financial institutions can conduct tokenized deposit business under existing financial regulatory laws without additional rules.

OSFI said financial institutions and third parties acting on their behalf must ensure their activities comply with applicable laws and regulations. It also asked institutions to contact the OSFI supervisor responsible for oversight before launching new products or services and recommended seeking legal advice before going live. The agency oversees nearly 350 financial institutions and 1,200 pension plans.

data.title: Canada's OSFI Says Tokenized Deposits Are Legally Equivalent to Traditional Deposits
data.description:
Canada's banking regulator said tokenized deposits are not legally different from traditional deposits and that the underlying technology used in a financial product or service does not determine its legal nature. According to ChainCatcher, the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions said financial institutions can offer tokenized deposit services under existing financial regulatory laws without additional rules.

The regulator said financial institutions and third parties acting on their behalf must ensure their activities comply with applicable laws and regulations. It also said firms should contact the OSFI supervisor responsible for oversight before launching new products or services and recommended seeking legal advice before going live. OSFI oversees nearly 350 financial institutions and 1,200 pension plans.

data.title: Iranian Atomic Energy Organization Chief Heads to Vienna for IAEA Conference
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Vice President and Atomic Energy Organization chief Mohammad Eslami has departed for Vienna to attend the 70th General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
